newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-OLIVEIRA, COSTA CALLED UP TO FACE FRANCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-OLIVEIRA, COSTA CALLED UP TO FACE FRANCE.

text.p: Porto striker Domingos Oliveira and club captain and central defender Jorge Costa have been recalled to the Portuguese squad to face France in a friendly in Braga next Wednesday. Oliveira and Costa have only just returned to duty with Porto after injury. Oliveira was out for four months after undergoing knee surgery, while Costa had his nose broken by AC Milan's Liberian striker George Weah in a European Cup clash last November.
Goalkeepers - Vitor Baia (Barcelona, Spain), Rui Correia (Braga).

Defenders - Paulinho Santos (Porto), Sergio Conceicao (Porto), Oceano Cruz (Sporting), Fernando Couto (Barcelona, Spain), Helder Cristovao (Deportivo Coruna, Spain), Dimas Teixeira (Juventus, Italy), Carlos Secretario (Real Madrid, Spain), Jorge Costa (Porto).
Midfielders - Jose Barroso (Porto), Luis Figo (Barcelona, Spain), Paulo Bento (Oviedo, Spain), Rui Barros (Porto), Rui Costa (Fiorentina, Italy).

Forwards - Joao Vieira Pinto (Benfica), Jorge Cadete (Celtic, Glasgow, Scotland), Domingos Oliveira (Porto), Hugo Porfirio (West Ham United, England), Nuno Capucho (Guimaraes), Ricardo Sa Pinto (Sporting).
